integrity: Finite exact calculations and finite simulations supplement but do not prove the asymptotic theorem; the stochastic convergence follows from a finite-time martingale fluid limit and a deterministic terminal-error bound.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of vertex classes and strictly positive limiting fractions; uniform independent atomless edge priorities.
Convergence of normalized jammed population in probability and L1; no finite-size rate or Gaussian fluctuation statement.
No claim about spatial diffusion, nonuniform rates, or growing numbers of parts.
Product-form mean-field kinetics may be implicit in earlier unequal-density annihilation literature; specialized exhaustive bibliographic verification remains unperformed.
title: A product-form jamming law for random dimers on complete multipartite graphs
